import os
import stat
import time

import pytest

# Import the public API from the Doorstop package
from doorstop import build, importer, exporter, publisher
from doorstop.common import DoorstopError


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
# Helper functions
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
def _create_document(tree, path="doc.yml", prefix="doc"):
    """
    Create a new document in the given tree and return the Document instance.
    """
    return tree.create_document(path, prefix)


def _add_items(document, count, name_prefix="Req"):
    """
    Add `count` items to the given document.
    """
    for i in range(count):
        document.add_item(name=f"{name_prefix} {i+1}")


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
# Test cases
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
def test_U02_4__Decision_Tab__TC-001(tmp_path):
    """
    Store requirements in a permanent and secure manner
    """
    # Build an empty tree in a temporary directory
    tree = build(cwd=str(tmp_path))

    # Create a new document
    doc = _create_document(tree)

    # Add a single requirement
    item = doc.add_item(name="Requirement 1")

    # Reload the tree from disk to verify persistence
    tree2 = build(cwd=str(tmp_path))
    found = tree2.find_item(item.uid)

    assert found is not None, "Item was not persisted to disk"
    assert found.name == "Requirement 1", "Item name mismatch after reload"


def test_U02_4__Decision_Tab__TC-004(tmp_path):
    """
    Support thousands of requirements (boundary)
    """
    tree = build(cwd=str(tmp_path))
    doc = _create_document(tree)

    # Add 1,000 items
    _add_items(doc, 1000)

    # Verify that all items are present
    assert len(list(doc)) == 1000, "Not all 1,000 items were added"


def test_U02_4__Decision_Tab__TC-005(tmp_path):
    """
    Support thousands of requirements (boundary)
    """
    tree = build(cwd=str(tmp_path))
    doc = _create_document(tree)

    _add_items(doc, 1001)

    # Verify that all items are present
    assert len(list(doc)) == 1001, "Not all 1,001 items were added"


def test_U02_4__Decision_Tab__TC-006(tmp_path):
    """
    Support thousands of requirements (boundary)
    """
    tree = build(cwd=str(tmp_path))
    doc = _create_document(tree)

    # Add 5,000 items
    _add_items(doc, 5000)

    # Verify that all items are present
    assert len(list(doc)) == 5000, "Not all 5,000 items were added"


def test_U02_4__Decision_Tab__TC-008(tmp_path):
    """
    Failure scenario - storage failure
    """
    tree = build(cwd=str(tmp_path))
    doc = _create_document(tree)

    # Make the directory read‑only to simulate a storage failure
    tmp_path.chmod(stat.S_IREAD | stat.S_IEXEC)

    # Attempt to add an item; expect a DoorstopError due to write failure
    with pytest.raises(DoorstopError):
        doc.add_item(name="Should fail")

    # Restore permissions for cleanup (not strictly necessary but good practice)
    tmp_path.chmod(stat.S_IWRITE | stat.S_IREAD | stat.S_IEXEC)
